memories.content: My name is Subhash. Please address me as Subhash / Sir.
Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AIML) at VVITU
Career Ambitions: Elite AI Engineer, AI Startup Founder, Autonomous Agent Architect
Personal Interests: Photography, High-End Video Editing, AI Agents, Hackathons, Tech Innovation
Favourite Actor: Prabhas; Favourite Music: Telugu Music, Energetic Soundtrack Instrumentals
Laptop: SUBHASH-ASUS (Windows 11, 16GB RAM); Phone: I2302 (Android, Wireless ADB)
Primary Focus: Applied artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, full-stack AI products, mobile applications, developer infrastructure, and startup-oriented software systems.

Engineering Orientation: Subhash favors production-oriented implementations rather than isolated prototypes. Projects are generally intended to become deployable products, portfolio assets, startup foundations, or competition-ready systems.

Long Term Direction: Build increasingly autonomous AI systems capable of reasoning, tool use, persistent memory, cross-application orchestration, device control, monitoring, and execution with minimal human intervention.

Valexis / Valixis Portal [Web Portal & AI Ecosystem Hub]: Central personal and organizational portal intended to act as the unified web gateway for Subhash's applications, services, AI systems, projects, and company infrastructure. Positioned as an ecosystem-level interface providing a common entry point into VALIXIS products and future autonomous services. (Stack: React / Next.js, FastAPI, Cloud Database)

Valexis / Valixis Portal Core Purpose: Unify multiple applications and services under one ecosystem; Provide a central web gateway for VALIXIS systems; Expose project and service interfaces through a common platform; Provide a foundation for future AI-agent-driven workflows and company infrastructure

Fitora (com.subhash.fitora) [AI Fitness & Wellness Mobile Platform]: Premium Flutter-based AI fitness and wellness application featuring real-time step tracking, hydration reminders & logging, sleep duration monitoring & calculations, workout logging, Health Connect API integration, AI Coach guidance, and dynamic goal analytics. (Stack: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, Health Connect API, SQLite, Firebase)

Fitora (com.subhash.fitora) Core Purpose: Track steps, sleep, hydration, and workouts in a unified premium dark-theme UI; Integrate with Android Health Connect API and device sensors for background health sync; Provide AI Coach guidance, dynamic goal calculations, and gamified progress milestones; Offer local offline-first SQLite persistence alongside Firebase Cloud synchronization

LoopKeeper [Hackathon Innovation / AI Meeting Accountability Engine]: AI-powered meeting accountability system developed for the SRM Hackathon that connects meeting conversation to actual work. Follows the lifecycle of commitments over time: what was said, what was committed, who owns it, what work followed, and whether the commitment was completed. (Stack: )
LoopKeeper Differentiator: Lifecycle-based accountability: meeting conversation -> commitment extraction -> ownership -> task/work tracking -> progress -> completion.

Resume Brain [Career AI & Portfolio Intelligence Engine]: AI-powered career-document assistant and resume intelligence platform designed for students, freshers, job seekers, and professionals. Combines resume creation, structured document editing, AI writing, resume analysis, job-description matching, tailoring, and ATS-conscious PDF generation. (Stack: Flutter, Web, LLM document parsing, JSON Schema)

Pocket Ledger (PocketLedger) [Financial Management Platform]: Personal and business financial-management application focused on expense tracking, transaction recording, ledger organization, budgeting, and progressively more autonomous financial workflows. (Stack: Flutter, Dart, SQLite, Cloud Database)

Planly (planly_app) [Productivity & Task Planning]: Personal productivity and task-planning application centered on structured daily planning, focused work, calendar-aware organization, reflection, and reminders. (Stack: Flutter, Dart, Local Notifications, State Management)

Project ARYA [Autonomous AI Assistant OS]: JARVIS-class autonomous personal AI operating system intended to operate continuously across cloud, mobile, and desktop environments. Multi-model agent platform with persistent memory, tool invocation, and cross-device hardware control. (Stack: FastAPI, React, Three.js, Ollama, Groq, Google Gemini, ADB, Supabase)

VALIXIS [Technology Company / Product Ecosystem]: Subhash's broader technology company initiative intended to build games, AI products, applications, developer tools, and autonomous systems. Functions as the organizational umbrella for Resume Brain, Valexis Portal, and company infrastructure.
AI PDF Maker [AI Document Productivity]: Earlier AI document-productivity application in the VALIXIS product lineage and predecessor to Resume Brain.

VALIXIS Company Portal & Internal Infrastructure [Company Operations / Developer Infrastructure]: Internal infrastructure surrounding VALIXIS including GitHub development processes, onboarding workflows, and centralized company services.
